phase: RoomAI Phase 8 — Exterior Detector Data Quality and Error-Reduction Plan

porch_investigation.diagnosis: Porch class suffers from extreme data starvation (1 train box) and an erroneous 100% full-frame test label in oi_ext_test_0106.txt.
porch_investigation.required_new_samples_estimate: 150-250 diverse porch images with verified localized boundaries (entryway porticos, colonnaded verandas, wrap-around porches).

scene_correlation_and_leakage_audit.cmp_prefix_analysis: CMP Facade source splits (train, eval, test) from original dataset were preserved into yolo splits (train, val, test). Near-duplicate analysis indicates some contiguous facade views or similar street corners share building architecture across splits.
scene_correlation_and_leakage_audit.leakage_risk_assessment: Low-to-moderate scene correlation in CMP facades; strict file-level separation exists, but semantic building overlap is present.

b2_vs_b3_fair_comparison.evaluation_protocol: Standard Ultralytics COCO 101-point PR curve interpolation across confidence sweep [0.001, 1.0] and IoU thresholds [0.50:0.05:0.95].
key_takeaways: B3 RFS boosted mAP50 by +0.0232 (from 0.3961 to 0.4193) and mAP50-95 by +0.0145 (from 0.2427 to 0.2572).
B3 improved building recall significantly (+8.33%, from 37.5% to 45.8%) and door precision (+6.01%).

However, porch remained at 0.0000 recall and 0.0000 mAP50 because oversampling 1 single training image 15 times cannot teach the model how to localize porches on unseen buildings, and the test split contains a 100% full-frame ground truth error.
Pillar recall actually dropped (-3.91%) under B3 RFS due to competition with oversampled facade features.

bottlenecks.title: Severe Rare-Class Data Starvation & Full-Frame Test Annotation Artifact (`porch`)
bottlenecks.impact: Only 1 train box exists for porch (imbalance ratio 3,332:1), while test image oi_ext_test_0106 has an erroneous 100% full-screen box, making 100% of porch test evaluations invalid.
bottlenecks.recommended_action: Correct the erroneous test box with verified ground-truth boundaries, and inject 150-200 curated, verified exterior porch images into train and val splits.

bottlenecks.title: Extreme Spatial Downsampling of Slender Architecture (`pillar_column`, `molding_deco`)
bottlenecks.impact: Over 52% of pillar boxes have width < 8 pixels at 640px input resolution, attenuating feature maps in standard P3/P4/P5 strides and causing massive false negatives (recall < 25%).
bottlenecks.recommended_action: Evaluate higher inference and training resolution (800x800) matching Phase 5/6 success on indoor small objects, coupled with specialized small-object loss weighting.

bottlenecks.title: Hierarchical Boundary Ambiguity (`building` vs `facade`)
bottlenecks.impact: CMP masks annotate facade planes, while Open Images annotates entire building envelopes. When evaluated together, overlapping predictions of facade and building cause mutual false-positive penalties.
bottlenecks.recommended_action: Clarify hierarchy: either unify envelope vs plane annotations or apply cross-class IoU suppression during post-processing.
